scope: The round brick church in Thorsager in April 2009, with the tower, chancel, curved apse, south porch and surviving west block.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The parish identifies the round church, its brick construction and the Romanesque architectural family.
The national tourism record identifies the Romanesque round nave, chancel and apse, with later porch and lower western tower remnant.
